newsitem.title: USA: Church & Dwight sees deal adding to earnings.
newsitem.headline: Church & Dwight sees deal adding to earnings.

text.p: Church & Dwight Co Inc said Thursday its $30 million acquisition of a group of five household cleaning brands from Dial Corp should "quickly" add to its earnings.
The company was not immediately able to provide information on how much it would contribute to its earnings.
Church & Dwight is acquiring Brillo soap pads and related products, Parsons and Bo-Peep Ammonia, Cameo Metal Polish, Rain Drops Water Softener and Sno Bol Cleaners.
The company said they are currently running at an annual sales level in excess of $40 million and are profitable.
The acquisition of is still subject to regulatory approval and is expected to close before the end of August.
The company declined to disclose a dollar value on the effect of the acquisition on earnings. It said it won't be noticeable until next year.
